01_bm25.text: Beware of Essential and how it does business. I am extremely disappointed in the Essential PH-1 phone and the company's support model. I bought the PH-1 phone from Amazon who only sells it via third party resellers as Essential the company does not directly sell their phone through Amazon. Within two weeks, the PH-1 camera stops working so I contacted Essential for support. Keep in mind that Essential sells phones but does not have a phone number to contact them for support. They only communicate through email. I describe the problem to them and they request additional information from me: my name, address, proof of purchase, serial number, etc. After providing them with all the data, they inform me that they will not support me because I bought the phone from a reseller. They said they only support the phone if it is bought directly from Essential and Amazon.

This phone is for people that want a company that will support their device and their customers, and not lock it down. This is the first generation Essential PH-1, and there have been weird quirks and bugs, and that's to be expected, but Essential has done what no other modern device manufacturer does: updates and customer service. That in itself is work the price that's half of what you'd pay for another "flagship" device.

This is really impressive. Essential published the December security update at the very same day as Google did for their Pixel 2 phones. No other company did this. And everything looks extremely promising for future updates - The Essential PH-1 has an open Android 8.0 beta test with detailed instructions for manual installation, covered under warranty. Reports say that the software experience is further improved even in the beta version. - The Essential PH-1 will get hardware abstraction layers (HALs) for much easier and faster updates (Project Treble). While all phones that are released with Android 8 or newer are required to implement Treble, phones updated to Android 8 can choose if they want to support it. Essential is one of only three companies that confirmed Treble support. All the big players will not add support to old phones.

The main competitor to the Essential PH-1 that I considered was the OnePlus 6. The Essential PH-1 has not been a disappointment, and I do not regret choosing this phone. Their support is also good but unfortunately you don't get any actions besides them being (responsive and nice) with their international customers for obvious reasons of Limited Warranty. In a nutshell I can say that I can't recommend this phone to anyone because it just dies after a couple of weeks of using it, LITERALLY! At least that's what happened to my unit. (the picture attached showing the screen while it's ON) Here's my detailed experience if you're interested: It all started in mid-Jan when I got my brand new EP from Amazon. It was all okay with some hiccups every now and then, I knew that before getting it but I believed in Essential team's frequent updates.

Beware of Essential and how it does business. I am extremely disappointed in the Essential PH-1 phone and the company's support model. I bought the PH-1 phone from Amazon who only sells it via third party resellers as Essential the company does not directly sell their phone through Amazon. Within two weeks, the PH-1 camera stops working so I contacted Essential for support. Keep in mind that Essential sells phones but does not have a phone number to contact them for support. They only communicate through email. I describe the problem to them and they request additional information from me: my name, address, proof of purchase, serial number, etc. After providing them with all the data, they inform me that they will not support me because I bought the phone from a reseller. They said they only support the phone if it is bought directly from Essential and Amazon.

Originally gave 5 star. The phone is dead less than a year old. A Coworker's phone is also dead. These phones are having a hard time making a year. Build quality seems good. My phone started restarting more and more. Essential customer support will not reply and stand behind the year warranty.

Support is non-existent. Phone is defective.. The lithum-ion battery shipped with the phones are defective. You will experience 12% discharge per hour... while the phone is powered down. Please save yourself the headache. I have had an open ticket with the support team since December 24th, 2018, it is now January 9, 2019. They wait on average 51 hours before responding. They request repeats of diagnostic steps. They offer no solutions and they refuse to admit that the problem may be related to hardware issues. I'm not sure if they're just hoping I'll go away, or if the plan is to continue stalling all support tickets until they file bankruptcy. This item should not have been permitted to be brought to market and Amazon should be ashamed for selling it on their website.

Horrible bad customer service. - No possibilities for repairs outside the US. I dropped it once and the screen had cracked. I live in Europe, so it is impossible to get it fixed, because there is no repair service for people outside the US. Don't buy it, if you live outside the US.
5 stars for only 1 reason company's support for the .... 5 stars for only 1 reason company's support for the product. Camera has improved a lot even in low light
We're so disappointed that it has been discontinued, but so impressed that Essential continues to support updates admirably. That is what you call really excellent customer service!

This phone is for people that want a company that will support their device and their customers, and not lock it down. This is the first generation Essential PH-1, and there have been weird quirks and bugs, and that's to be expected, but Essential has done what no other modern device manufacturer does: updates and customer service. That in itself is work the price that's half of what you'd pay for another "flagship" device.

I used to be able to watch YouTube in my bed on my Galaxy s6 with 1 bar of Wi-Fi. Now it is the same with the essential phone, accept it just buffers, and does not want to load until I move it closer to the router. Nice. -Terrible Customer Support. Wouldn't help me work through my camera issue that I have been having since the beginning. Apparently buying open-box phones from amazon voids warranty. -Some have issues with camera motor. Camera makes buzzing sound and doesn't focus. -Bad camera. Pathetic low-light performance. Pathetic contrast performance (ie if you take a picture of a room and focus on the room itself, during the daytime the window in the background will appear white from over exposure). Slow focus speeds. -Screen protectors - Do not even bother with this. None will even fit. It's a hit or miss. I wouldn't bother.

A gorgeous device with great customer support. The phone exudes quality. It feels great in your hand. Software updates come regularly. It's free of bloatware. They have wonderful customer support agents (American support agents in America, no less). Fast charging is great. I miss having a headphone jack, but their audio adapter dongle works well. The main built-in camera is so-so. For comparison, it's not quite as good as the camera on my iPhone SE (which is the same camera as on the iPhone 6s). The Essential camera is worse in low light, and detail is lacking. Hopefully they will improve the camera software in the future. At the lowered price, it's a great deal.

Be worried for service issues!. I purchased my Essential phone directly from their web site with the two year warranty. Within a month the glass at the top of the screen, where there is a very thin gap for phone speaker (when actually using the device as a phone) has cracked off on one side. I contacted support to see if this was a known issue with these phones. They market this device as more rugged than other phones. The glass has proved this to be false. But Essential support came back immediately with "go contact the insurance company since you purchased the extended warranty". The phone is alittle over a month old! Feel very stupid for buying into Essential and trying to support Andy Rubin's effort instead of just sticking to a Pixel or Galaxy device.

Wouldn't turn back on, even to the reset screen (holding down power and volume down buttons). Totally bricked. I contacted Essential, and it was about as good as a customer service experience can be. After trading a couple quick emails with a rep (they wanted to make sure I wasn't an idiot and has actually tried everything), they sent a return shipping label (FedEx overnight), and got me a new phone (brand new, in box) overnighted back. They were quick about every step of the process. I'm not going to knock my 4-star rating, because they handled the issue ideally. Support was perfect.

It's awesome.... When it works.. I've had an essential phone for 4 months. At first, I loved it. I was raving to everyone about how awesome it is. It is a well-designed phone. Then the problems started. For the last week, my phone has been freezing sporadically and requiring a power cycle to keep it going. I contacted support. After going through half a dozen troubleshooting steps, I was advised by support over email (Essential doesn't have phone support) to factory reset it and wipe all of my data. Just yesterday the phone started randomly deciding it didn't have a sim card installed and dropping my calls. Power cycling or removing and reinserting the SIM card fixes the issue (for about 5 minutes of call-time) I contacted essential support again and was told that it was a "carrier issue" and to contact my carrier.

Android Auto doesn't work. I went through 3 phones and Android Auto simply doesn't work on this device... THe reason why it isn't a 1 star review is because the support for the device is great from the customer service of Essential... THe reason why it doesn't get 4 stars is the annoying little things from stock Android, and the removal of tons of features when updating from 8 to Android 9 Pie.

Great Device, Lack of Customer Service. (Fingerprint Sensor Failure). I love the functionality of the device, but after Android 10 the Fingerprint Sensor was concluded as dysfunctional. However, I talked to the company support and both of the third party retailers: Amazon, and ElectroWireless all telling me that they can't do anything for me. Rubbish the is. Might as well give it a One-Star rating. They couldn't give me any other solutions or ways to troubleshoot my issue. However, the sensor is not the most needed hardware on the device, it is a modern feature and adds value, but not when it doesn't work. To conclude my options ran dry sat the end and none of the companies could assist me or give me a refund because the device has been past the warranty expiration date.

I read (after having this problem at least one other customer having exact same problem with no help from essential because he purchased from amazon-3rd party) Has anyone else had this problem and how did you resolve it ? About to attempt a warranty claim with Essential because no sound renders this useless as a PHONE !?

While the phone was a great prime day buy. 1 star is a comprehensive rating for hardware, and customer support from Essential. I test drove this phone for a week comparing it directly to my unlocked samsung galaxy s8. Both running oreo. While the phone was a great prime day buy, it just could not hold up the S8 on almost every front. Camera, Speed (both operational and downloads), overall look and build. Just no comparison. I tried both back and forth on Verizon and ATT. Still the S8 was superior. On the company side of things, I had 2 issues that Essential totally dropped the ball on (probably because the are going out of business) 1) Glitches with bluetooth. Their tech support immediately started with deflection of issue. We all know what this is. It usually starts with try another app, or get me way more information than they possibly need.

I thought that the issue may be with my set but the other phone in our family also had call drops. In fact once I did further research the Essential phone seems to have documented issues with TMobile reception (Reddit etc). My other big issue with Essential was the customer service - they initially were very responsive and even called me back after I left a voicemail on the weekend - but that was that they were interested in logging the 'ticket' and 'follow up' but the solutions offered seemed to be web queries etc and without a genuine interest in alleviating the customers issues or customer satisfaction. They did not even mention or acknowledge the issues with TMobile reception. When I said can you replace my phone the answer was we will flag that up the chain and get back to you.

Incompetent Customer Service. This was, until two weeks ago, a phenomenal phone. Then the screen stopped working. I tried soft resetting it, hard resetting it, factory resetting it; the device could register inputs (the little vibration to recognize fingerprints, for example) but the screen would simply not return any information. Weird, but hey, it's an amazing piece of technology that's going to fail from time to time. Since they don't have a storefront, I figured it's just an easy matter of getting ahold of a customer service rep and initiating a warranty evaluation - I'm just inside the limited warranty period, and since the phone had never been dropped or dunked in a toilet or anything exotic, it never occurred to me that a company without physical stores would be completely beneath the task of handling a complaint like mine. Heads up: they are.

And their software issues are getting fixed quickly, but they need to fix the antenna on the next version for sure as numerous people report this problem. I am eagerly following this company to see the next iteration of the device as I will get it for sure.

with Amazon excellent with the software of the essential phone Evil I .... with Amazon excellent with the software of the essential phone Evil I have a lot of problems with the games and the technical support has been a disaster very pro very bad

Looks nice, but beauty is only skin deep. Terrible reception, cannot get data in numerous parts of a very large city where my old Samsung worked fine. Also have had problems receiving texts. Looks great, feels solid and well-constructed, but that's just a facade, this thing is not ready for market. And the kicker is that Essential customer support is among the worst I've dealt with in all my years, it's galling how arrogant and dismissive they are about problems.

Phone doesn't work with AT&T after several tries with AT&T support including visits to their store. This phone doesn't work well at all. After spending more than two months thinking that it is AT&T problem, I'm convinced that it is the device problem. AT&T support spent several hours on the phone and at store, they replace SIM etc but the phone doesn't connect to the network most of the time. It is so unreliable and shows no connection when 3 other phones connect very well from the same spot. I won't recommend buying this device.

Works with Verizon... Excellent device ...No camera issues. Excellent phone. Works with Verizon. The store rep could not help. I had to call 611 from Verizon phone and talk to technical support person (not general customer service) to get the phone working. Ask them to turn on HD voice calling from their end so you can start making nf receiving phone calls. No problems with camera or 360 degree camera. Fabulous device. I was initially sceptical reading bad reviews about camera but I did not have any problems.

I will note that I like how minimalist the phone is and how much space it provides. I was going to try to replace instead of refund but it looks like I need to pay full price (and customer support said I may get a refund for a portion afterward). I think I'll just return and find something new.

Essential refuses to assist customers with defective items. If you are reading this I recommend reconsidering purchasing this device. Everything worked correctly for a few hours, but suddenly the audio from my headphones stopped. I have tried all of the methods I know of to fix strange problems like this. Restarting, a factory reset, developer options, etc. Nothing worked. The speakers on the phone still worked, but using the included adapter did not. I collected a large amount of information regarding the problem I was having and sent it to Essential to see if they could help me. I am not an expert, they should know more. They did not help me at all. They could not confirm if it was the adapter or the phone that was the source of the issue. They did not even try to, perhaps I had already exhausted all the options they would otherwise tell me to attempt.

Not reliable - Failed after 10 months, support refuse to fix/replace - stay away.. The device is showing an error "device is corrupted" during boot after 10 months of usage. Support claim we side loaded the device even though we did not and refuse to fix it. In addition finger print reader is not reliable.

Product repair replacement. Phone seemed of good quality with a cracked screen it became inoperable. Contacting essentials support gave me a run around, no repair possible on any of these phones. After sending them all information required for a $200 replacement. I have been told I do not qualify. Bad purchase decision !

Nothing, finally around 3/7 or 3/8 I was fed up sending reviews or what not to get an update. So after going into the depths of space and time to find someone to contact specifically about the phone and wtf was going on I got in touch with a lady who had no info at all said she was get me in touch and a manager would call me. They did about 20 mins later and basically this is what she said. I asked for a replacement which was an option by the way... the only option, its the same thing return/replace... she explains because its a third party they cannot do a replacement... So basically I was waiting for like 2 weeks for an update on my replacement it said was coming that never existed or should have been a choice.

3. Details to come, I immediately panic, because they’re asking me for things like a screen shot of my low battery (seriously) before they can validate the claim. OH, AND THIS IS WORTH SAYING NOW. THERE IS NO PHONE SUPPORT. ZERO. Even now, almost a week later, this whole story transpired over email, so when I am clear to share it, you’ll see the whole story. 4. 4. So now, the smoking gun. They offer me two choices. 1) If I want to stay with Essential, I have to send my phone back, wait for them to verify my issues, and only then, get my phone back. The wait? They can’t say exactly, BUT AROUND FOUR BUSINESS DAYS. And again, this is all via email, no call. 5. 5. And now, the best. Option 2.

This is really impressive. Essential published the December security update at the very same day as Google did for their Pixel 2 phones. No other company did this. And everything looks extremely promising for future updates - The Essential PH-1 has an open Android 8.0 beta test with detailed instructions for manual installation, covered under warranty. Reports say that the software experience is further improved even in the beta version. - The Essential PH-1 will get hardware abstraction layers (HALs) for much easier and faster updates (Project Treble). While all phones that are released with Android 8 or newer are required to implement Treble, phones updated to Android 8 can choose if they want to support it. Essential is one of only three companies that confirmed Treble support. All the big players will not add support to old phones.

After a month the phone is not working properly; .... After a month the phone is not working properly; I cannot hear the incoming callers voice nor can the caller hear me. I am coming to believe I threw away my money. I contacted technical support but so far the phone is not working properly.

Photos of the front and back of the device: (attach) 6. Please let me know how these troubleshooting steps work out. I look forward to your reply. Sincerely, Cathy Essential Customer Experience Team Woke up the other day (Jan.2) to a dead phone that will not turn on nor charge! I contacted (website mail) Essential Phone company to get repaired or replaced (1yr warranty). Its been two days now and no response...

Sleek phone but one drop and you'll wish you went ahead and bought a different phone. Customer service terrible.. Customer service terrible. Product even worse. Will never again purchase an essential product. Shoddy material. Useless after one drop. I now have a $550 paper weight. I've dropped a phone before and had it cracked, but it was still usable as in most cases with most phones. This one? Good luck. I also hear they will be coming out with Essential home. I would stay away from that as well seeing that they really don't care about their customers.

Works but has a few issues. Battery is lacking, the customer service is awful.. I bought this phone over six months ago and have had nothing but issues with the phone lasting less than a day. I use it minimally and still can't get it to last past 5pm. The charger sometimes works sometimes doesn't. The phone overall has few glitches but if it's endlessly dead and not functional. DO NOT BUY.

Phone was great.... for one day :(. Extremely disappointed in Essential, 1 day after receiving the phone the OLED screen began going out and I was absolutely loving the phone. Called amazon customer service and they were extremely helpful, had actually called so early they stated I needed to call back later for it to process in the system. Factory reset the phone after this just in case it may have been anything else, phone began working fine again. But next day yet again began seeing the OLED go out then the phone turned off and will not turn on again. Shame because I was really loving the phone, got a refund and debating getting something else now instead. Got an amazon store card just to get this phone.

Fragile with little to no support.. Most breakable phone ever. Mine broke after 5 days of use at about a 6 inch drop. All this before my case could arrive. There is a long list of things I would like to do with $500 before just throwing it away. Cases are hard to find because few companies make them. Repairs are very difficult, this phone has a super low repair-ability score. No company I can find offers repairs. In short, how can I support a company who can't support me? I can't believe I bought 2 of these.

Said compatible with Verizon, but after purchase, not totally true!. I love the phone when first got it. It did connect to Verizon simply with my old sim card from old phone immediately. But since date of purchase, phone randomly disconnects itself half a dozen times in less than 3 months, have to reboot each time to reconnect. Most of the times, we didn't catch issues until its too late. Amazon indicates "Get Support" in your orders section, ours show no "Get Support" We sent to email to vendor, they reply 30 days only, and that had passed. We sent email to Essentials.com, we got more technical rhetoric: Reboot/Update/Let us know. Bottom line, it's paper weight, and we are replacing it. There are other great phones that work flawlessly out there, make another choice. Our recommendation >>> DON'T BUY

Turned it on, logged into my Google account, a few auto updates, turned off, then DEAD. I returned this dead phone for a replacement after a few terrible hours of ownership. I tried to revive it as per support on the official company website. Nothing. Giving this phone one more try and will revise my one star rating to reflect as such. But honestly I am thinking I just move on and get something else. Buyer beware! I do not recommend purchasing this phone from any 3rd party because it is highly likely you will be returning this phone for a replacement or refund. Good luck with a 'replacement or refund' with 3rd party sellers.

Dead-end phone with no support.. Manufacturer refuses to honor replacement warranty. Company is going out of business, according Rubin's information. Lots of small bugs in the phone. Apps crash. Camera is trash, still, after all those fixes. I had really high hopes because they promised the moon.

GREAT Phone. Amazing phone! Perfect design in all fashion's! Only downside, is reception is slightly weaker than all my other phones. But their customer service is helping with settings. Personal pet peeve, wish I could change navigation buttons around. Honestly smart design overall!

The first time I had an issue with the charging cord and one arrived at my door a day or two later. This time, I found our past email exchange in my Outlook history and just replied with my new issue (my fault- it needed some old stuff deleted so it froze a couple times). Low and behold there was an actual human there who replied to me with some suggestions within the hour! Its working again with its usual snappy response time and I'm a happy customer. Thanks Essential, I'm glafd I found you! (I remember when Kindle USED to have this kind of service). I don't even care if this phone has another problem down the road because I know there will be a very pleasant person to respond to me personally and very quickly to do what they can to help.

Phone stopped working after one year.. Buyer beware. Reached out to Essential support and basically stuck with an expensive phone that stopped working after a little over a year. No water damage, just powered off and will not turn back on. I would not recommend buying this phone as it is not durable and no phone repair guy can fix it.

Can no longer recommend this phone. No support.. This was a great phone until the most recent system update. Now I have flaky Bluetooth and mobile data issues where the settings just randomly turn off. Company is refusing to honor their warranty. I can no longer recommend this product.
Thank you Amazon for prompt service. Hope this review will be of some help to anyone who is planning to buy this mobile.

Stopped working after 4 months. Initially this phone worked great, but then last one month giving lots of problems and stopped working today. The support needed in October and issues strted in Nov. m bDon't know if the issue is the phone or purchasing from Amazon. Please don't buy.

Tale of two phones. This has really been a tale of two phones. I bought two essential phones, one for myself and one for my wife. This is a review of the one my wife got, because they both performed very differently. First, the camera. Essentials camera app was known to be bad, but after several updates, they've gotten it to work decently right? Wrong. This camera app is trash on both mine and my wife's phone, only on my wife's phone it would routinely freeze her phone when she tried to take pictures. I had to go to support and they were helpful, but the issue never really went away. It just gradually happened less frequently. Essential as a company really failed on that front.

6 months old phone wont recharge, vendor nor manufacturer wont back warrranty. stay away from this phone vendor and the bayshine store, phone is 6 months old and won't charge more than 2% neither wants to support the product

Battery issue after 3 months, no real warranty service, not repairable. I have the phone for 3 months and performance is pretty good. Until you get a battery problem and the Essential service department simply ignores you and does nothing. Now the battery is lasting 10 hours at best (if I don't really use it), and it turns out the phone is rated 1 out of 10 for repairability. An Iphone 7 is 7 out of 10. There is no support that will get back to you and the warranty appears to be a dead letter. Not ready for prime time. DON'T BUY.

This device is a globally unlocked device. So what does that mean that means that she out you guys have carrier support for pretty much every carrier in the United States and every GSM carrier abroad and it's a very seamless plug-and-play experience all you have to do is drop your sim card in and you should be good to go. No need to program APNs or do any other type of smartphone trickery or magic so to speak to get your device to work on your carrier. I'm really glad essential decided to make their device globally unlocked in my opinion I feel like we need to have more globally unlocked devices because these devices are a lot of money so why not give your customers the choice to run on any carrier they want. So good job essential.
Solid phone with great customer service team!. Excellent phone. Performs well. Gets system updates around same time as pixel phones. No bloatware! Customer service at Essential is excellent!

DOES NOT work on Verizon, despite what Essential claims. Does NOT work on Verizon, even though support at Essential says it will. Sending back for a refund due to false advertising by Essential **Essential announced on 9/15/2017 that this phone was now certified on Verizon. I hadn't shipped it back yet, so I gave it a try again on 9/19/2017. The phone still doesn't work on Verizon. When I enter my IMEI on Verizon's website it still says the phone is not supported, and the Verizon tech in chat said it's not supported. Essential Support here says it's supported on Verizon, but Verizon disagrees. Based on continued false information from Essential, the 1 star review stays.

So they will not honor warranty. I would expect a phone to work more than a year. The aggravation of l;osing the phone and dealing with their customer service is not worth it. And it seems many people are having the same experience. Buy a different phone from more reputable company.
Don't buy - quality not as represented. Don't buy, my new phone had a slightly loose screen and smashed in the first week. Also no support offered outside of the US.

Excellent build quality - you can only compare this build quality with an iPhone X 3. Lots of space! 128GB of space is quite useful when you have to install tons of apps 4. Its blazing fast 5. Essential support and commitment to push Android updates - I received Android Pie update the same day it was released by Google! Even before many of the Pixel owners that I know! The only regret I have is I didn't buy the Matte Grey color. I should have paid attention when buying that Matte Grey was an Amazon exclusive and would have less chances of slipping from your hand.

Phone died in first update of Android system. I tried contacting the manufactured that did not give me ways to unlock the phone after failed update. Then did not give me alternative to send the phone back. Then I contacted the seller through Amazon, that ignored my letters. After the warranty expired, I repeated my attempt directly to Amazon for a claim for no other responses from manufacturer and seller... I am in a chat for hours and all they tell me is that I must go back to the manufacturer... So, it is not working the A to Z guarantee that should give me the power of getting a claim against other sellers and then getting protected by Amazon. (NOT HAPPENING so far)
Awful experience. I am having the worst phone experience that I ever had, and, specially, with the Costumer service! Do not buy it!

Good phone, good quality no bloatware and unremovable default apps. Worth every penny. Good phone. Like the quality build and the nonñ bullshit stock Android, timely updates. Some sort of customization/personalisation on top of the stock Android is all I needed to set it up just as I wanted. The only thing, that would be nice is dual SIM support.
Great phone!. It gets 5 stars once it works on Sprint... Works on Sprint now. As usual, Sprint was slow to support it... about a week slow. Great phone!*

Essential phone is steaming pile of crap!. One star since zero isn't an option. I bought this phone directly from essential. Received it Mon. Oct 30/2017. Ran fine for ONE DAY Issues: Locking up requiring reboot repeatedly Will Fi turns itself off Menu screen scrolls open without touching the screen. Keypad stops working when trying to input numbers while on a call. Customer service?! Ha! There is none! You get voicemail, that's right, freaking voicemail in 2017 and no return call. I am beginning to think this is actually a big, elaborate scam.
Great build quality. Extremely fast updates. Excellent customer service.

Nothing has improved. I was texting today... texting... and my phone froze for a good 3 seconds while I tried to text a response back. Really? I'm not playing games on this. I'm texting, surfing the web, using gps, pretty much "essential" stuff, right? Imagine this phone in a year, or two years, with these issues. I visited the android forums to find out why. Turns out these are hit and miss issues and certainly they exist for many buyers. I'm giving this a week before sending it back and buying a pixel 2. I like underdogs. I support start ups. This phone, though, needs to be fixed soon or I'm sending it back. Even at 500... I can't recall the last time I,spent this much and has similar issues. Essential, fix this phone! I want to support you.

Great tech support.. Purchased the essential directly from the website with warranty. So far the phone has been great, current updates and tech support response is fast. The phone is well built and I don't mind the extra weight of the phone. If you want a flagship phone without the flagship price this fits and I suspect any phone or electronic device for that reason if dropped will end up on the losing end.

Heavy, bad cell and wifi radio. This phone has a great design. The notch is so small as to be almost totally unobtrusive and the materials feel really high quality. The price is a great value. The software and quick updates is fantastic. The options to customize how to use the notch space is great, especially since some apps didn't have good default support. - On the flip side, this phone is extremely heavy. That did not bother me at first, but over time it became very annoying. I noticed that my hand would feel fatigued, notably where my pinky supported the phone. - The peripheral support is lacking: I couldn't find a truly slim case - Wi-Fi reception is noticeably worse than other devices that I use - The deal breaker: this phone does not work well on tmobiles network.

Great phone at a great price. Great phone, no problems at all getting it to work with Verizon network aside from having to turn off "Enhanced 4G LTE Mode" to make calls. Aside from that, Essential Support Staff is very quick to help and their follow-up is excellent. The phone itself is extremely well made, has a nice weight to it and is very durable. It fell off a table and slid along a hardwood floor on it's back and left zero marking on the surface. By far, my favorite part of the phone is the fact that it's Pure Android, meaning there are no excessive bloatware preloaded into the system that cannot be deleted. 100% Recommend purchasing this phone to anyone looking to get a great quality, high functioning, durable phone that does not require a contract

The sales rep said they had had several problems with the Essential phone activating on their network. I was looking forward to this phone and now I have to find a weak replacement that will probably cost more than this one did.

Couldn't tell the difference between brand new and renewed when side by side. First of all. I know people like to gripe... but if you read carefully in the "product reviews" the vast majority of complaints are customer service (or the lack thereof) issues. That belongs in the seller reviews so overall, the cumulative product rating, in my opinion, should be much higher. This phone is as straight forward an ANDROID as it gets WITHOUT all the carrier bloatware at all. Do ads pop up, yes, but blame google/google chrome for that, disable notifications, etc., and use Firefox with "duck, duck go" or whatever. I bought this because... you guessed it... my original PH-1 Essential got immersed. Even though it is "dust/water resistant", it doesn't mean that it will crap out if it gets submerged or soaked for an extended period. There's still a chance that it will fail, especially with ocean (salt) water.

A bunch of cool magnetic add-ons available, like speakers and 360 degree camera. And ignore what you have read about the camera quality. 13 megapixel snaps, HD video, all yours on the stock PH-1. The software updates have eliminated whatever problems there were with camera quality from the beginning. I have never taken better pictures with a phone. This phone is the future of Android. Rebel against Apple I-phone obsolescence. Hold this phone, try it out, fall in love like I did. Support the efforts of Andy Rubin (Android's daddy) to make a better, more solid, future-proof product in a world of disposable handheld devices. I @#$% love this phone. I am an Essential customer for life. (Note: my review is of a phone I bought through Sprint, so it lacks the "confirmed purchase" whatever stamp. But buy this phone and help me put the Koreans out of business.
I just installed Feb 2020 update. This is such a surprise to me as I thought Essential would stop updating the system after the 2-year support ended back in 2019. Shout out for Essential company!

Absolutely stunning!. This phone deserves a lot more attention. It definitely blows away other phones in almost every aspect. The build quality is top notch only comparable to iPhone. The bezeless screen is a huge plus with a notch that I almost forgotten about after few weeks of use. The PH-1 was the phone of the year in 2017 and continues to be so in 2018 at least in my opinion. A characteristic it shares with none of the other phones which go out of style after 1 year of use. Also it's worth mentioning that technical support is prompt, genuine and hence excellent. It's a shame the follow up phone planned was reportedly killed. I would certainly hope that And Ruben et Al reconsider.

I really wanted to like this phone. I really wanted to like this phone. I purchased it for the extra storage and the 360 camera. The package deal on Cyber Monday was hard to pass up. With that said, the phone could not even perform basic functions without freezing, like having multiple pages open, or going back to the home screen after taking a picture. There was also times where the phone would shut off for no apparent reason, and it would take minutes before it came back on. I emailed Essential's support line, but other than "clearing my cache" and rebooting, they were not much help. I wanted to save money by getting this phone, but I guess you get what you pay for. On a brighter note, the 360 camera was pretty awesome. Just not awesome enough to keep a phone that has substandard performance.

There's a noticeable difference in sound volume between the loudest volume (too loud) and the one volume lower than the loudest volume (not loud enough). **As of 2/3/2020, Essential company declared Essential phone lost cause. No more Security and Software Updates and Customer Support. The phone barely survived for 2 and 1/2 years in the market. Would not recommend buying this phone!

I had looked at another phone (that is getting really rave reviews) and was just about to purchase it but after hearing the customer service from the company was awful, I decided not to. Another phone everyone is talking about this year, I heard the updates are sent very infrequently. I wanted a good quality product by a company that backs up what they put out. Was it perfect? No. They are putting out updates to fix it all the time and I love that. It's a solid and gorgeous phone. And oh... no bloatware! Fantastic.

In an effort to maximize screen space they built the camera right in the middle of it. It can be a little distracting when watching videos on it. *NO SD CARD SLOT: You can't expand the storage space on this phone, although with 128GB on board that should be plenty for most users. *LONG TERM SUPPORT?: At the moment the company is very active in providing timely updates and responsive to customer questions on social media. There have however been articles stating that the company is in financial trouble. If true support for this phone could end abruptly if the company goes under. Over all the phone is very snappy. It fit the bill almost perfectly for me. A very powerful phone at a low price. It has a few minor drawbacks but overall I am very satisfied with my purchase.

Finally, I returned the phone and ordered a replacement. The replacement arrived on a Friday and worked properly for the entire weekend, making me think that my first phone had just been defective. Monday morning, the exact same issue started happening again with the replacement phone. I reached out to Essential and received absolutely no help. No amount of factory resetting or installing all available updates would get the phone to work properly. I finally had to return the second phone to Amazon as well, and even though this phone COULD have been really nice, I would not recommend it...

All my hard work and feeling of having a phone to my liking was now reset to factory. Now all I have to show for my hard work is a nice phone that is reset that still won't access the internet over the air only via WIFI. I want to love this phone! But now I must return it. The worst part is the time I spent is lost and now I will be without a phone until I get a new phone. Amazon and Essential, please help me to love this phone, it has so much potential. I am posting an update. Amazon provided info for essential support and they contacted me with things to check. Nothing worked. I left them phone off for 8 hours and apparently Sprint reset the Phone on their network. All the issues were Sprint an not the phone.

I see essential phone company website have instruction on how to solve the problem, and I followed the instruction, problem still remain. I send e-mail to company. I can not find the phone number of customer service. I did receive the letter back very soon. essential told me the problem is caused by not completely unlock the phone. and it has to be solved by Sprint. I am not sure whether i can solve this problem, so I have to return it. wait for refund now . good phone, but may not buy used one. I have not upgrade the first phone, and still using it right now.

Phone won't hold a charge, after just three months!. I bought this for my wife in July. It started running out of power early in the day just a few days ago. I just learned our "window" for customer support "closed" yesterday. Being an iPhone user, she was never happy with the Essential, but i thought she would learn the Android system in due time. But now, the phone won't keep a charge and can't be depended on. I'm just glad I only paide $250 for it. She'll be going back to an Iphone asap.

If you're cool with buying over and over and shipping back (I really don't mind, it's not a huge deal) and can expect to be disappointed, then roll the dice and see what shows up. I did spend 28 minutes on the phone with someone from Amazon Support to see if I could get a partial refund and just deal with the phone as-is, but I was told over and over that there's not an option in their system to allow that - they can do an immediate refund only, or refund once the shipping label clears as shipped. If I could have just kept the crumby one for $150 or so, I would have. Good luck! The phone itself is pretty great. Everything they say about the camera app is true, and the fork of the Pixel camera is glitchy.

"This Limited Warranty does not apply to Third Party Products". Touch screen was a bit buggy when it got dirty but I ignored it since I liked the phone overall (especially the price). After about 8 months the display was having issues and now won't show anything at all. I contacted Essential and they said it was not covered under the warranty because it was a third party seller, which was really annoying since I bought it on Amazon which they specifically said was an authorized reseller. Buyer beware.
